caseName: Brown v. Brown & Root U. S. A. Inc.
caseNameFull: Brown v. Brown & Root U. S. A. Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of appellant for a free white Christian male bench denied. Appeal dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.,
